variables.name: ControlDatabaseName
variables.note: Fabric SQL Database item name/connection target for the ELT control schema. Was hardcoded as a literal in several pipelines.

variables.name: BronzeLakehouse
variables.note: Bronze layer lakehouse. Replaces the hardcoded BronzeWorkspaceID/BronzeObjectID pipeline parameter defaults.

variables.name: SilverLakehouse
variables.note: Silver layer lakehouse. Replaces the hardcoded SilverWorkspaceID/SilverObjectID pipeline parameter defaults.

variables.name: GoldLakehouse
variables.note: PLACEHOLDER - no Gold lakehouse item exists in this repo yet. Replace itemId once one is created; do not leave as all-zero in Test/Prod value sets.

variables.name: TimeZone
variables.note: Windows time zone ID used by ELT.uf_GetAestDateTime and GetIngestDefinition. Was hardcoded as 'AUS Eastern Standard Time' in T-SQL.

variables.name: MaxIngestInstance
variables.note: Row cap passed to ELT.GetIngestDefinition. Was a hardcoded literal '100' in the Master ELT ASQL pipeline's Lookup activity.

variables.name: MaxTransformInstance
variables.note: Row cap passed to the Level1 transform lookup. Kept in sync with MaxIngestInstance by convention, not by mechanism.
